readings: Considering only tracks whose file size (`Bytes`) is strictly greater than 10,323,804 bytes, group them by `MediaTypeId`. For each media type, compute the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds`, ignoring missing values) and the number of tracks. Then return a single row with (1) the average of those per-media-type bytes-per-millisecond averages and (2) the average of those per-media-type track counts, both unrounded.
queries: SELECT AVG(avg_bpm), AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId)
